description: Header file defining the PeripheralController class, which manages input device peripherals such as lights and batteries, including setting colors, player IDs, and retrieving battery info.

classes.name: PeripheralController
classes.description: Class implementing peripheral device control, including lights and batteries management.

methods.name: setLightColor
methods.description: Sets the color of a specified light.

methods.name: setLightPlayerId
methods.description: Sets the player ID for a specified light.

methods.name: getLightColor
methods.description: Retrieves the color of a specified light.

methods.name: getLightPlayerId
methods.description: Retrieves the player ID of a specified light.

methods.name: getBatteryCapacity
methods.description: Gets the capacity of a battery.

methods.name: getBatteryStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a battery.
